description: This file implements an admission plugin for Kubernetes that automatically provisions namespaces when they are requested but do not exist. It defines the Provision class, which handles admission requests, and includes methods for setting up dependencies and validating initialization.

classes.name: Provision
classes.description: An admission plugin that auto-provisions namespaces if they do not exist when requested.

methods.name: Admit
methods.description: Handles admission requests, creating a namespace if it does not exist.

methods.name: SetExternalKubeClientSet
methods.description: Sets the Kubernetes client for the plugin.

methods.name: SetExternalKubeInformerFactory
methods.description: Sets the informer factory and initializes namespace lister.

methods.name: ValidateInitialization
methods.description: Validates that the plugin has been properly initialized.
